items.title: HIMS Investor Alert: Kessler Topaz Meltzer & Check, LLP Encourages HIMS Investors with Losses to Contact the Firm
items.summary: A securities fraud class action lawsuit has been filed against Hims & Hers Health, Inc. (HIMS) for allegedly making material misstatements about its privacy practices. The FTC accused HIMS of sharing customers' medical information with third-party advertisers including Meta and Snap, and charging consumers for prescriptions immediately despite promising consultation with medical providers. The stock declined 14.73% on the news. Investors who purchased HIMS securities between August 4, 2025 and July 29, 2026 can seek lead plaintiff status by November 2, 2026.

items.title: Deadline Approaching: Hims & Hers Health, Inc. (HIMS) Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact Law Offices of Howard G. Smith
items.summary: A securities fraud class action lawsuit has been filed against Hims & Hers Health, Inc. following an FTC lawsuit alleging the telehealth provider shared consumers' sensitive health information with third-party advertising platforms and engaged in deceptive billing practices. The stock declined 14.73% on the news. Investors who purchased HIMS securities between August 4, 2025 and July 29, 2026 have until November 2, 2026 to file a lead plaintiff motion.

items.title: Kaplan Fox & Kilsheimer LLP Alerts Hims & Hers Health, Inc. (NYSE: HIMS) Investors to a Securities Class Action Deadline on November 2, 2026
items.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Hims & Hers Health, Inc. for the period between August 4, 2025 and July 29, 2026. The FTC sued the company for failing to disclose immediate prescription charges, making subscription cancellations difficult, and sharing consumer health information with third-party advertising platforms like Meta and Snap. The stock fell 14.73% following the FTC allegations. The lead plaintiff deadline is November 2, 2026.

items.title: Why The Trade Desk Stock Rallied Today
items.summary: The Trade Desk stock surged 4.9% after the FTC and 22 states filed suit against Amazon for allegedly using deceptive ad pricing practices, including undisclosed surcharges. This legal action highlights The Trade Desk's competitive advantage through transparent pricing and could help the company recapture market share from competitors with closed ecosystems.

items.title: Securities Fraud Investigation Into Hims & Hers Health, Inc. (HIMS) Continues – Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact The Law Offices of Frank R. Cruz
items.summary: The Law Offices of Frank R. Cruz is investigating Hims & Hers Health, Inc. following an FTC lawsuit alleging deceptive privacy practices and unauthorized sharing of customers' medical information with third-party advertisers like Meta and Snap. Additionally, Visa placed Hims on its Acquirer Monitoring Program due to excessive customer complaints and credit card disputes in its weight-loss subscription business, resulting in significant surcharges. These developments caused substantial stock price declines.

items.title: An Insider at Hims & Hers Just Filed. Here's What It Says About Buying the Dip
items.summary: Hims & Hers' Chief Legal Officer Soleil Boughton sold 21,500 shares (~$605,000) on August 14 through a non-discretionary tax withholding transaction, retaining 339,075 shares. The sale does not reflect a shift in the insider's assessment of the company. Despite the stock's -40% one-year return, the underlying business shows strength with 38% revenue growth to $753.2 million last quarter and raised full-year guidance to $3.1-$3.3 billion. However, an FTC lawsuit over data sharing and billing practices creates uncertainty, with a $47.5 million legal contingency already impacting earnings.
